## Spatial analysis

::: {.cards}

::: {.card-et}
### Pedestrian casualties on London's roads
<p class="meta">2026 · Python, GeoPandas, OSMnx, PySAL, statsmodels, Leaflet</p>

An open, reproducible analysis of every police-recorded pedestrian casualty in Greater London from 2021 to 2025: network kernel density hotspots, Getis-Ord Gi* clusters, a negative binomial model of the built environment, and drive times to major trauma centres. Includes a spotlight to explore any place and a year-by-year playback.

<p class="links"><a href="https://etymo.co.uk/london-pedestrian-safety/">Dashboard</a> <a href="https://github.com/eritrouib/london-pedestrian-safety">Code</a> <a href="posts/2026-10-athens-to-london/">Write-up</a></p>
:::


::: {.card-et}
### Pedestrian collisions in Athens
<p class="meta">2021 · MSc Geoinformatics, NTUA · R, ArcGIS Pro, Esri Dashboards</p>

Spatial-temporal analysis of 1,318 pedestrian collisions in the Municipality of Athens (2008–2017): hotspots, space-time cube, network analysis and Geographically Weighted Regression of the built environment, with an emergency services dashboard.

<p class="links">Article in preparation</p>
:::

## Planning and geospatial tools

::: {.cards}

::: {.card-et}
### Article 4 and constraints checker, Kingston
<p class="meta">Web tool · JavaScript, Leaflet, Planning Data API, proj4</p>

A Local Land Charges aid for the Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames. Check a single property by address, postcode or grid reference, or upload a CSV to check hundreds at once. Each location is sent to the government's Planning Data service and checked for Article 4 directions, conservation areas, listed buildings, tree preservation, green belt, flood zones and SSSIs. Nearby features and boundaries within a chosen tolerance (10, 25 or 50 m) are flagged as borderline, and Article 4 results are cross-checked against Kingston's own boundaries, with an offline fallback if the service is down.

<p class="links"><a href="https://etymo.co.uk/Article4Kingston/">Open the checker</a> <a href="https://github.com/eritrouib/Article4Kingston">Code</a></p>
:::

:::

## Interactive calculators

Small, research-based calculators that turn evidence into something you can try for yourself. They all live together at **[Reality Checks](https://realitychecks.app)**.

::: {.cards}

::: {.card-et}
### Reality Checks
<p class="meta">Website · realitychecks.app</p>

A home for all my calculators: quick, honest reality checks on everyday habits and money, each based on published evidence and clear about what it can and can't tell you.

<p class="links"><a href="https://realitychecks.app">Visit Reality Checks</a></p>
:::

::: {.card-et}
### What's your lifestyle costing you?
<p class="meta">Calculator · HTML, JavaScript</p>

How everyday habits (alcohol, smoking, activity, sitting, sleep, BMI and diet) relate to life expectancy, based on seven peer-reviewed studies and ONS life tables for England and Wales. Population averages, not a personal prediction.

<p class="links"><a href="https://etymo.co.uk/life-calculator/">Try it</a> <a href="https://github.com/eritrouib/life-calculator">Code</a></p>
:::

::: {.card-et}
### What's your coffee habit really costing you?
<p class="meta">Calculator · HTML, JavaScript</p>

Your yearly spend on coffee, tea and other drinks, and what that money could grow to if invested instead, with a "cut it by half" scenario.

<p class="links"><a href="https://etymo.co.uk/coffee-cost-calculator/">Try it</a> <a href="https://github.com/eritrouib/coffee-cost-calculator">Code</a></p>
:::
